company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, founder-led transport and technology company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It provides long-distance bus travel and a growing passenger-rail service across Central Europe. Using an asset-light model, it works with regional partners to operate many routes while managing the booking platform, network planning and brand. Its digital services include online booking, trip tracking and travel extras.

Technology is central to Corvale’s approach: the company describes itself as engineering-led, with teams owning their systems end to end. Scaling data and machine-learning use is a strategic priority, as is sustainability. Corvale has also ordered a new train fleet to support its rail expansion.

Its stated values are **“Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey.”** The company emphasises international collaboration, shared goals, problem-solving and individual ownership of career development. Employees describe the culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas. Corvale has received workplace culture awards in areas including innovation, work-life flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation.

The company has technology offices in Kraków and other Central European cities, alongside operations offices across its network. Employees can work hybrid and receive travel benefits, while many technology roles are also open to independent contractors.
